name: pastZone
meaning: IDPASTACTIONZONE (prop 0x34) via Scn_GetPropBox (0x4522c5); the zone he patrols/chases in while inFuture == 0 (0x454ed5)

name: cineBox
meaning: IDCINEBOX (prop 0x14) via Scn_GetPropBox (0x45234e); its presence chooses the start state 9 (0x4525d5) and it is the arrival cinematic's box (0x453f5d)

name: cineBox2
meaning: IDCINEBOX2 (prop 0x18) via Scn_GetPropBox (0x452365); box of the second cinematic, played from msg 0x1e (0x454d21)

name: futureZone
meaning: IDFUTURACTIONZONE3 (prop 0x30) via Scn_GetPropBox (0x452337); his zone while inFuture != 0 (0x454e38)

name: futureZones
meaning: IDFUTURACTIONZONE (prop 0x28) id list: Scn_FindIdList into boxes/count (0x4522f2); searched by IsInActionZone and ChaseWolf (0x454ea0, 0x4552f3)

name: myBox
meaning: his model's first collision box (0x4524e9); half of the box-overlap test that carries the Wolf while fleeing (0x4529bd)

name: wolfBox
meaning: g_pWolf's model's first collision box (0x452519), the other half of that test

name: state
meaning: current state, the switch selector of Update (0x452904) and written by SetState (0x454f68)

name: prevState
meaning: state before the last SetState (0x454f56); state 7 (play one animation) switches on it when the animation ends (0x453b4b)

name: mashCount
meaning: button presses counted while struggling out of his hug (0x455939); > 6 within 1500 ms frees Ralph (0x45594f)

name: squeezeTicks
meaning: updates counted in state 1; a camera shake at 5 and at 0x10 (0x452e5d); reset by SetState(1)/SetState(3) and on an animation end (0x452e3e)

name: grabKind
meaning: 0 = grabbed by msg 0x39 (time portal), 1 = grabbed by msg 0x3a (carried), 0xff = release done; drives state 6 (0x45360c)

name: hugStage
meaning: 0 none, 1 hug started (state 4 first press), 2 hug broken (0x45326b); cleared by PostLoadInit/Reset

name: pad0a2
meaning: tail padding before the s32 at 0xa4

name: distToTarget
meaning: Vec3s_DistXZ to the current target, the divisor of every velocity in this class (0x452f3d, 0x4533bc)

name: timer
meaning: ms accumulator (+= g_dtMs at 0x452e06, 0x454433, 0x455acb)

name: mashStartMs
meaning: timer when the struggle's first button press arrived (0x455912)

name: mashLastMs
meaning: timer at the last struggle button press (0x45592a); 800 ms without one resets the struggle (0x455a29)

name: timerLimit
meaning: ms limit compared with timer in states 0 and 11 (0x452943, 0x45441e)

name: target
meaning: offset to the current target, or the absolute position the Wolf is pinned to while carried (0x4529b9-0x452ac3)

name: vel
meaning: velocity in units/s, fed to Vec3s_ScaleByDt (0x45308d); also reused as an absolute position for SetPosition in the grab (0x4546e9)

name: step
meaning: this frame's translation: Vec3s_ScaleByDt output and Collide_ResolveMove in/out (0x452b8f)

name: pad0ca
meaning: tail padding before the pointer at 0xcc

name: grabPos
meaning: &sender->pos stored by msg 0x38 (0x4548aa) and steered to in state 3

name: startPos
meaning: his position after PostLoadInit's SnapToGround (0x4525a1); Reset puts him back here (0x45283e)

name: pad0d6
meaning: tail padding before the ContactInfo at 0xd8

name: contact
meaning: Collide_ResolveMove output used by states 0 and 7 (0x452bc1); contact.wallObj at 0xdc is polled for class 0xb

name: unusedF4
meaning: written 0 by PostLoadInit (0x45254c) and Reset (0x452852); never read

name: fleeing
meaning: 1 once the second cinematic has sent him down IDFLEEINGTRAJ (0x454249); gates the movement half of state 7 and makes Reset resume the flight instead of returning him home

name: hugging
meaning: 1 while Ralph is being squeezed and the struggle input is being counted (0x4531ab)

name: fleeTraj
meaning: IDFLEEINGTRAJ (prop 0x24) via Scn_GetPropTrajectory (0x45237c); the path he runs when he flees

name: patrol
meaning: the follower along fleeTraj, initialised at 0x4524bd with speed 1000, bias 0x800 and arrive radius 0x32

name: inFuture
meaning: toggled by msg 0x39 (the time portal, 0x454947); selects futureZone(s) instead of pastZone in IsInActionZone

name: wolfHeld
meaning: 1 while he holds Ralph frozen: set from !g_pWolf->HandleMessage(this, 0xf, 0) and cleared with msg 0x40f 4 (0x452b4a, 0x4540ff)

name: cinePending
meaning: set by msg 0x11 (0x454d81); state 0 turns it into the flee animation and clears it (0x452d16)

name: hasFled
meaning: 1 after the flee has been started (0x454239); msg 0x1e does nothing once it is set

name: patrolActive
meaning: 1 = state 0 walks the trajectory; cleared when the state-0 timer runs out (0x452d8c)

name: dustParams
meaning: his dust: {10, -20, 0x800, 0x155, 0x28, 0x5a, 0} written by PostLoadInit (0x452753-0x45279f)

name: dust
meaning: 16-particle dust trail, constructed by the factory (0x452247) and reset by PostLoadInit (0x452742)

name: soundHandle
meaning: handle of the looping sound started by SetState(0) (0x4550c9); stopped there and by Reset

name: pad2be
meaning: tail padding before the u32 at 0x2c0

name: cineId
meaning: IDCINEMATIC (prop 0x1c) (0x4523ac)

name: cineTextId
meaning: CINETEXT (prop 0x08) (0x452428)

name: cineId2
meaning: read from prop 0x1c as well (0x4523ea): IDCINEMATIC again, not IDCINEMATIC2 (prop 0x20), which nothing reads

name: cineText2Id
meaning: CINETEXT2 (prop 0x0c) (0x452462)

name: cineFlags
meaning: CINEFLAGS (prop 0x00) (0x4523cb)

name: cineFlags2
meaning: CINEFLAGS2 (prop 0x04) (0x452409)

name: cineText
meaning: Text_GetClassString(cineTextId) (0x452443), or 0 when the string is empty

name: cineText2
meaning: Text_GetClassString(cineText2Id) (0x45247d), or 0 when the string is empty

name: cineStage
meaning: 0 none, 1 arrival cinematic started (0x453ef5), 2 flee cinematic started (0x454cff)

name: pad2e1
meaning: tail padding to sizeof 0x2e4
